correctness.rationale: Parseval for |P|² gives M4=sum_d |C_d|² for 12 roots; direct independently enumerated difference multiplicities 12 singleton,24 double,18 quadruple, one zero. Group each K4 triangle double-correlation block into 3+|q_ij+q_ik+q_jk|² to obtain M-180=2Σ_{4 triangles}|sum q|²+Σ_{18 four-pair shifts}|C_d|². Four triangle vanishing equations enforce opposite-edge product equalities; three four-pair constraints in unique four-anchor gauge force two conjugate sixth-root arrays. Independently reconstructed SOS for many random phase sets and verified both equality gauges. The gauge has 8 free phases for finite mu_q and orbit size q^4; independently enumerated all 2,142,594 normalized arrays q=2,3,4,5,6 in exact integer / sqrt5 pairs, obtaining (188,216,188,240-20sqrt5,180) and normalized optimizer counts (3,16,9,24,2). This finite enumeration exhausts only finite-alphabet refinements; continuous optimum/equality follow analytic identity. Difference exponents lie in [-2,2]^3, giving no aliasing for grid orders >=5.

originality.rationale: This is the all-twelve-root irreducible A3/cuboctahedron single-polynomial L4 optimization, not the six-point planar A2/triangular theorem, nine-point planar square, or 12-point rectangular Fourier prism. Those supports have different difference-multiplicity structures and constraints; despite equal mode count for prism, its restricted minima (220,210,188,196) do not imply the A3 values. Golay complementary sets optimize sums of multiple arrays rather than a single array. Historical cuboctahedral phase-array catalogs remain possible overlap.
residual_risks: Only all twelve nonzero oriented A3 roots, unimodular amplitudes, full Haar measure or no-alias finite grid >=5.
Exact q-alphabet minima beyond q=6 not computed except universal attainability iff 6 divides q.
Primary Golay-array PDFs not all read; older polyphase classifications possible.
